findings.observation: The light-medium skin, freckles, heavy level brows, long straight nose, narrow upper lip, and mismatched earring remain recognizable, but oversized round eyes and heavily softened cheek-and-jaw planes make the 41-year-old source read childlike and doll-faced rather than preserving her mature round adult identity.

The figure retains Senia’s short soft-round construction, evident middle, broad compact torso, gentle limb contours, substantial trouser volume, and planted stance without converting her into a muscular or thin body type.

Although the upper arms and forearms remain softly proportioned, both source-natural hands become large, padded closed fists with compressed wrists, introducing generic chibi hand inflation and losing the palm-up source gesture.
Brown-chestnut hair preserves the close-cropped shaved silhouette and the offset temple razor detail with no new hair mass or unrelated accent.

The oxblood quilted outerwear, navy lining, reinforced cuffs, shaped cloth clasp, generous dark trousers, red ankle wraps, worn boots, and mismatched earring are preserved, but the source-visible wooden thread gauge is omitted entirely.

Visual measurement places hair top near y=201, chin near y=623, and grounded sole bottom near y=1352: the roughly 422 px complete head-and-hair unit occupies about 36.7 percent of the roughly 1151 px standing figure, slightly above the strict 32–36 percent / 2.75–3.1 range.
Exactly one figure appears with complete cropped hair and head, both hands, coat edges, trouser legs, wraps, and both boots fully visible inside generous parchment margins.
The broad grounded ready-idle, shaved head, high-contrast oxblood-and-navy quilted coat, separated arms, wide trousers, and planted boots form a clear combat-icon silhouette without a weapon.

The practical quilted cloth, trousers, wraps, and worn boots remain grounded mortal clothing; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
